annotations.text:
1. Board — empty state
The comparison board IS the home screen from the first open. Conversation is a single search-bar-style input, never a chat thread.

2. Board — gathering
Board already visible as skeleton rows. ONE inline prompt card (recap chips + next question) — no fixed sequence, no chat log.

3. Board — searching
Loading happens IN the board (inline steps + shimmering rows), not a full-screen takeover.

4. Comparison board
All ~5 providers visible + comparable at once (Match/Price/Rating/Signals columns), sortable. This is the primary/home screen, not a card-per-screen deck.

5. Provider details
Bottom sheet OVER the dimmed board (never full navigation). FACT/INFERRED sections + dimension bars, dashed = no data.

6. M10 loading
Same sheet, content swapped to loading — board still the anchor underneath.

7. M10 questions + M11 simulated answers
Same sheet again. Dashed amber SIMULATED cards + persistent no-contact banner. "Back to shortlist" collapses the sheet, doesn't navigate.

8. Error state
Inline on the board itself, search bar stays put — you never leave the shortlist view even on failure.
